title: The Way of Kings
summary: On the storm-battered world of Roshar, where highstorms scour the land and everything from plants to creatures has adapted to survive, a war rages on the Shattered Plains between the armies of Alethkar and the mysterious Parshendi. Kaladin, a former battle medic turned slave after being betrayed by his lighteyed master, is sold into Bridge Four—a crew of bridgemen forced to carry enormous bridges into battle as cannon fodder. Across the sea, the brilliant scholar Jasnah Kholin investigates the ancient Knights Radiant and the true nature of the Voidbringers. Highprince Dalinar Kholin, haunted by visions from a power beyond his understanding, struggles to unite the squabbling highprinces as a legendary storm approaches. A slave who cannot be broken, a scholar who pursues forbidden truths, and a warlord seeking redemption converge as the Desolation begins.
archiveDescription: This volume initiates the chronicle of Roshar, a world defined by its violent highstorms and the adaptive biology of its flora and fauna. The record documents the resurgence of the Knights Radiant—orders of investiture-wielding warriors thought extinct for millennia—through the experiences of a slave turned battlefield commander, a scholar pursuing forbidden historical research, and a highprince haunted by visions. The account provides foundational knowledge of Roshar's unique spren ecology, the Surges, and the ancient enmity between humans and the singers known as Parshendi. This is the first in a series of volumes recording what appears to be the return of the Desolations.
